item.title: Ancient ‘Luxury Pen’ Unearthed in Sicily: Erotic Depiction of Dionysus on 2,500-Year-Old Bone Stylus
item.description: A rare 5th-century BC bone stylus unearthed in Sicily features an erotic carving of the Greek god Dionysus—his bearded face atop an erect phallus—designed to mimic a protective herm. Described as "truly unique," the luxury tool or votive offering blends art, religion, and craftsmanship from ancient Greek Sicily, discovered during excavations in Caltanissetta.
